# Design

Keep the one-binary, local-only architecture. Add persistent attempts and normalized events beside leases in SQLite; derive liveness from heartbeats rather than task strings; use fencing tokens for ownership. Build a static host capability registry that generates MCP, Agent Skill, and hook integration safely. Feed hook JSON to a common event ingester whose deterministic fingerprints and workspace revisions drive an explainable progress classifier. Compose task packets from the existing spec, graph, memory, impact, and test primitives. Preserve detailed CLI and MCP commands while adding a smaller control-plane facade.
